column2: I have a Brainbase API key and no CLI. Using curl, show me how to start a task with a brand-new inline agent spec over the HTTP API, send it a follow-up message, and read its events as they happen.
I have a folder with instructions for an agent. Walk me through getting it onto Brainbase with the CLI from a fresh machine and kicking off a task I wait on, all from a non-interactive CI job.
A Brainbase task is running slowly on the default model. How do I switch it to a different model while it's running, from both the CLI and the API? And what does setting model to auto actually do?
Which sandbox providers does Brainbase offer, how do I pick between them, and how do I list and remove the machines my agents have left running?

Write a brainbase-orchestration.yaml where a triage agent hands confirmed bugs to a fixer agent, and the triage agent runs every weekday at 09:00 UTC. Explain how the handoff actually happens at runtime.
Connect my Brainbase agent to Slack using the CLI. I only have a PAT in CI. Also tell me what people can do with the agent inside Slack once it's connected.
Build a private dashboard for my Brainbase support agent that everyone in the org can open. Which harness do I need, how do I create and publish it, and how do I give it a nicer address?
I have a CSV of 50 support questions with expected answers. Create a Brainbase benchmark from it, run it against two models, and show me how to compare the results.
Add an eval to my brainbase.agent.yaml that fails any turn where the agent promises a refund. Explain where the verdicts show up and what the judge costs.
I need a Brainbase token for CI that can push agents but must not be able to manage members. Which scope, how do I create it, and what error will I see if I pick the wrong one?
Add my company's remote MCP server at https://mcp.example.com/sse, which needs an API key header, to my Brainbase agent's manifest, and show me how to verify it works from the CLI.
Install the skill acme/pdf-tools version 1.2.3 from the Brainbase registry into my agent, both via the manifest and the CLI, and tell me where it ends up on the Claude Code harness.
I want my Brainbase agent to remember each customer's preferences across tasks. Set up memory, define a table for it, and show me the tool calls the agent will make.
Set up auto top-up so my Brainbase org never runs out of credits, and tell me what consumes credits and how much one credit is worth.
